limitations: Only one module is substituted; every other source and generated UI input is shared and hashed.
Timing includes TASK-100 observer, call counters and phase-boundary full Run graph capture. Visual/AST allocation passes are separate from timing.
Nearest-rank n=3 P95 is the maximum observed sample, not stable tail latency.

Allocation counts cover table literals in seven named Lua UI modules only. They exclude closures, engine allocations, helper functions and VM internals. Node heap/RSS are not native Lua or phone memory.
The actual engine OnUpdate/bridge/portrait driver/GPU and official SDK export are not executed by this Host fixture.
Visual hashes cover every measured update of particle output fields plus actor portrait and hand transforms; they are mock field equivalence, not official pixel/quality approval.
Long replay is 3600 frames (60 simulated seconds), not an endurance/thermal device test.
